head: ### b754 — lane two, act one hundred and eighty-one, the sitting under (R364): b753 at its weight; the navigator`s corrections; the corrigendum opening on the four classes that repeated three acts running and on the post-seal events bank; the close`s yield, the anchors’ kernel tags and the doors read; the reference layer`s four anchors put, three re-cut and one retired, and five descriptions re-cut; the quoting rule, three rules of the record`s upkeep, the handoff page, the project set and its cuts, the update channel and five lines passed; I-109`s cross-reference and the Epstein document`s headings entered; the census`s next edition carried; the sourcing rules entered; nothing built and nothing computed
